name: Ferrite magnets
summary: Dark grey ceramic (ferrite) magnets: cheap, strong enough and everywhere.
identify: Grey-black rings on speakers, curved arcs inside DC motors, rings in microwave magnetrons, and flexible strips in fridge door seals and fridge magnets. They are brittle and chip or snap if dropped.
test: Stick it to steel: it should pull firmly. Cracked magnets still work, just weaker.
